m0-context.title: Load baseline context + verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read the g2 handoff, the seams (decoupled_longitudinal, braking_view, session_braking, terrain, segment_classifier), and the prove_synthesis_496 proof driver. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Confirm the gravity de-conflation: Variant A = F_vehicle/m + theta=0; Variant B = incumbent a_long + real theta.

postconditions.statement: handoff + seams + proof driver loaded; handoff complete; gravity de-conflation confirmed
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff complete (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present). Seams + proof driver read. Gravity de-conflation confirmed: A=F_vehicle/m+theta=0 (gravity in estimator z-map), B=incumbent a_long+real theta. Units consistent: driver_streams *0.1 to metres, KinematicSample.position metres.

m1-altitude-helper.title: Add altitude_at_positions helper to terrain.py
m1-altitude-helper.imperative: Add altitude_at_positions(px, py, profile) to src/physics/terrain.py, mirroring gradient_at_positions exactly (cKDTree nearest-centerline projection, returns profile['altitude_m'][idx]). Add a synthetic unit test in tests/unit/physics/layer2/ that builds a tiny profile and confirms nearest-centerline altitude lookup (no FastF1).

postconditions.statement: altitude_at_positions added; its synthetic test passes

m2-adapter.title: Build decoupled_braking_input adapter
m2-adapter.imperative: Create src/physics/layer2/decoupled_braking_input.py: a reusable adapter that runs estimate_longitudinal PER LAP over contiguous classified KinematicSamples, with terrain theta/z from the #497 z-map, and emits per-sample a_long/F_vehicle/sigma_a aligned to the classified samples. Anchor magnitude = clean_longitudinal_from_raw RAW a_long (honors two_cycle_external_anchor_design). Loud altitude_assumed_flat when terrain absent. Pure-logic seam (per-lap split, alignment, F_vehicle/m feeding) must be unit-testable without FastF1. Do NOT modify any production view.

postconditions.statement: adapter module imports cleanly and exposes the documented contract

check.command: py -c "import src.physics.layer2.decoupled_braking_input as m; print(sorted(n for n in dir(m) if not n.startswith('_')))"

constraints: honest per-sample sigma_a carried into sigma_kin

payload.cmd: py -c "import src.physics.layer2.decoupled_braking_input as m; print(sorted(n for n in dir(m) if not n.startswith('_')))"

m3-adapter-tests.title: Adapter unit tests (synthetic, no FastF1)
m3-adapter-tests.imperative: Add tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_decoupled_braking_input.py covering the pure logic: per-lap contiguous split + 1:1 alignment to samples, F_vehicle/m feeding into BrakingView with theta=0 (gravity-once), per-sample sigma_a propagation into sigma_kin (not broadcast), and the flat-terrain loud flag. All synthetic — no real session.

postconditions.statement: adapter unit tests pass without FastF1 cache

m4-sidebyside-script.title: Side-by-side comparison script
m4-sidebyside-script.imperative: Create scripts/braking_sidebyside_518.py: for each circuit x (VER,PER pooled), fit BrakingView two ways with the G1-DEFAULT HPs and cold-start supporting priors -- (A) adapter F_vehicle/m + theta=0; (B) incumbent prepare_braking_frontier path (a_long + real theta). Report per circuit (a_b,b_b), covariance, raw_p99 knee, capability ceiling, which is deeper, terrain effect. Emit reports/physics/braking_sidebyside_2023Q.{json,md}. Measurement only.

postconditions.statement: script imports cleanly (syntax + wiring) without running the full telemetry sweep

m5-run-and-report.title: Run side-by-side + full layer2 suite + simplification, write result
m5-run-and-report.imperative: Run the side-by-side script on all 6 circuits x VER+PER, producing the report. Run py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/ -q (green) and py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths (clean). Synthesize the retire/keep recommendation from the deciding numbers. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: report produced; full layer2 suite green; simplification clean on touched paths; result written

constraints: measurement only -- no retire decision made here
